系统应用仅提供查看、启动与 APK 导出。: System apps support viewing, launching and APK export only.
清除数据不可恢复；卸载会移除此 Android 用户的应用及数据。执行前请核对确: Clearing data is irreversible. Uninstalling removes this Android user's app and data. Review the confirmation plan before proceeding.
APK 导出包含已安装的 base 与 split，不包含应用数据；结果在待保存: APK export includes the installed base and split APKs, without app data. Save the result from Pending files.
选择一个应用查看详情和操作: Select an app to view details and actions
投屏在独立窗口打开，可使用键盘和鼠标操作所选设备。: Mirroring opens in a separate window. Use your keyboard and mouse to control the selected device.
投屏窗口中的键鼠和拖入操作会直接作用于当前设备。: Keyboard, mouse and drag-and-drop actions in the mirroring window act directly on the current device.
默认不传输音频，也不自动同步剪贴板。: Audio and automatic clipboard synchronization are disabled by default.
首次使用需要下载并校验官方 scrcpy 工具，仅安装到应用私有目录。: Download and verify the official scrcpy tool for first use. It is installed only in this app's private directory.
关闭投屏窗口或点击停止可结束本次会话；不会关闭设备或共享 ADB。: Close the mirroring window or click Stop to end this session. The device and shared ADB stay running.
